question: Can the failed O2.11 perception-only geometry prediction still REDUCE the established O2.9 8-trial target-imagery calibration burden when used ONLY as a fixed low-weight (one-pseudo-observation) prior?

frozen_prior.source: EXACT O2.11 Stage-A target prediction per target/ROI/outer fold (manifest 207b0bf, hash-verified)
frozen_prior.U_PRIOR_IN: within col(W_target), rank r_best; recovered as W_target.T @ B_IN_PRED (orthonormal in K-space)
frozen_prior.interpretation: WEAK INITIAL GEOMETRIC REGULARIZATION -- not an oracle, not a successful predictor, not established target geometry

resource_grid.note: ALL O2.9 grid cells with M*T<8

limited_residual.delta_i(S): mean_{t in S} delta_trial(i,t) from O2.7 certified trial_native

control_estimator.within: stack Z=[z_i]; q=min(r_best,M); deterministic top-q via Gram topk_energy_gram
control_estimator.outside: stack O=[o_i]; fixed D=2; deterministic top-2 Gram

hybrid_prior_principle.fixed_interpretable_strength: actual imagery observations dominate automatically as M grows

within_hybrid.e_IN: mean_{i in Ci} ||z_i||^2 (require > numerical zero floor)
within_hybrid.C_PRIOR_IN: (e_IN/r_best) * U_PRIOR U_PRIOR.T (trace == e_IN == one avg within-obs energy)
within_hybrid.fit: deterministic top r_best eigenvectors (prior supplies full-rank orientation even when M<r_best)
within_hybrid.gram_optimized: eig of Lambda^{1/2} Zin^T Zin Lambda^{1/2}, Zin=[Z|U_PRIOR], Lambda=diag(I_M,(e_IN/r_best)I_r); energy = sum top-r_best (w^T Lambda^{1/2} (Zin^T g))^2/nu

outside_hybrid.gram_optimized: eig of Lambda^{1/2} Zout^T Zout Lambda^{1/2}, Zout=[O|B_PRIOR_OUT], Lambda=diag(I_M,(e_OUT/2)I_2)

one_pseudo_observation_rationale: complete perception prior contributes the same total covariance trace as ONE typical real target-imagery observation; NOT performance-chosen; do NOT evaluate half/two obs, alternate lambdas, or component-specific weights; if it fails, seal failure

primary_inference.family: 4 sub-eight cells x 2 ROIs = EXACTLY 8 tests

prior_utility_supported: PERCEPTION_PRIOR_GAIN_SUPPORTED iff ALL: median DELTA_PRIOR>0; >=6/8 DELTA_PRIOR>0; Holm reject (no recovery threshold in this definition)
hybrid_sufficiency: HYBRID_OPERATIONALLY_SUFFICIENT iff: 8/8 evaluable; median TOTAL_RECOVERY_HYB>=0.50; >=6/8 TOTAL>=0.50; median FCF_HYB>=0.50; >=6/8 FCF>=0.50 (same as O2.9)
prior_enabled_cell: PRIOR_ENABLED_SUFFICIENT (ROI x sub-eight cell) iff BOTH HYBRID_OPERATIONALLY_SUFFICIENT AND PERCEPTION_PRIOR_GAIN_SUPPORTED
common_prior_enabled_success: COMMON_PRIOR_ENABLED_SUCCESS iff the SAME (M,T) is PRIOR_ENABLED_SUFFICIENT in BOTH ventral and lateral

new_minimum.N_TRIALS_PRIOR_STAR: min(M*T) over common prior-enabled sub-eight cells
new_minimum.MINIMAL_PRIOR_RESOURCE_SET: all tied common prior-enabled cells at that trial count

geometry_correction_diagnostic.dt_free: oracle uses 10 training-identity residuals, not held-out

reference_m4t2: compare hybrid vs sealed O2.9 control at M4T2 (improve/unchanged/harm); descriptive only

reference_m10t8.expect: target imagery dominates the one-pseudo-observation prior; hybrid approaches exact O2.9 full-resource

single_trial_secondary.enumerate: all 10 training identities x 8 repeat positions
single_trial_secondary.label: SECONDARY_SINGLE_TRIAL_PRIOR_CORRECTION_DIAGNOSTIC

evaluability: all frozen schedules in a participant x ROI x cell must evaluate; no selective schedule dropping; any schedule numerical/provenance fail -> whole participant cell non-evaluable; missing primary participant cell -> do NOT shrink 8-test Holm family -> technical inconclusive

pre_outcome_control_replays.A: O2.11 prior hashes reproduce Stage-A manifest 207b0bf
pre_outcome_control_replays.B: O2.9 no-prior control reproduces all tested reference cells
pre_outcome_control_replays.E: prior-only N=0 reconstructs sealed O2.11 predicted native geometry

synthetic_controls: 1 PERFECT PRIOR: hybrid needs fewer obs than control
2 USELESS ORTHOGONAL PRIOR: hybrid->control as M grows, no false gain
3 ANTI-INFORMATIVE PRIOR: may harm low-resource; gain test detects no benefit
6 ONE-PSEUDO-OBS TRACE: trace(C_PRIOR)==mean obs energy exactly
7 ZERO DATA ENERGY: technical failure not prior-only fit

two_stage.STAGE_A: verify prior manifest + O2.9/O2.7 state + freeze schedules + compute control(replay of sealed O2.9)+dt-free hybrid geometry diagnostics from training only; persist/hash; commit; push; server-verify; NO held-out HYBRID retention
two_stage.STAGE_B: after Stage-A seal: verify hashes; open held-out imagery; evaluate R_CONTROL/R_HYBRID; participant aggregation; DELTA_PRIOR; exact 8-test signflip/Holm; operational sufficiency; common prior-enabled frontier; seal

roi_status.PERCEPTION_PRIOR_IMPROVES_BUT_NOT_TO_OPE: >=1 sub-eight cell supported DELTA_PRIOR but none operationally sufficient
roi_status.PERCEPTION_PRIOR_OPERATIONALLY_SUFFICIEN: hybrid reaches sub-eight sufficiency but prior gain not Holm-supported
roi_status.PERCEPTION_PRIOR_NO_SUPPORTED_BENEFIT: no sub-eight cell supported gain and none qualifies

program_status.PERCEPTION_PRIOR_BENEFICIAL_BUT_EIGHT_TR: gains supported but no common sub-eight operational solution
program_status.SUBEIGHT_HYBRID_RECOVERY_WITHOUT_PRIOR_U: common sub-eight hybrid operational solution but prior-gain inference does not establish prior caused it
program_status.PERCEPTION_PRIOR_DOES_NOT_REDUCE_TARGET_: no common sub-eight hybrid operational solution and no supported common prior-enabled reduction

positive_allowed: although the perception-only predictor was insufficient by itself, using that frozen prediction as a weak one-pseudo-observation prior reduced the prospectively tested target-imagery calibration burden from eight observations to N
the perception phenotype contained operationally useful prior information even though it was not sufficient for direct geometry prediction
negative_allowed: the failed perception-only prediction did not provide enough useful prior information to reduce the established eight-observation target imagery calibration burden under the frozen hybrid update
negative_forbidden: no non-imagery prior could ever help

next_gate.REDUCES_BELOW_EIGHT_and_min4or6: O2.13 PRIOR-CORRECTED RESOURCE REFINEMENT (no new model search)
next_gate.BENEFICIAL_NOT_REDUCED: O2.13 SUBJECT-SPECIFIC GEOMETRY COVARIATE DIAGNOSTIC (low-dim non-imagery covariates improve fixed prior)
next_gate.DOES_NOT_REDUCE: O2.13 SUBJECT-SPECIFIC GEOMETRY COVARIATE DIAGNOSTIC (do NOT tune failed prior; prospectively limited anatomical/behavioral covariates, N=8 low-capacity only)

O3_policy: even if O2.12 reduces calibration to 2-6 imagery observations, O3 remains locked; lower operational burden != shared/causal operator; O3 reconsidered only after subject-specific calibration mechanism characterized and independently validated
